IMPORTANT: ONLY ONE complete character, target yaw 225 degrees. NOT an atlas or sheet. Output portrait 1024x1536 with 64 pixel clear safety margins. No mirrored costume; cape stays anatomical LEFT, vine and ruffles stay anatomical RIGHT. Back-facing views must show back of bodice and head, no face through head. Preserve same clothes silhouette and gravity.
